_: Region sheet for naga-kur-deeps (2.5a1b). Talk is seeded from the region's published place records; every trait cites a lore dossier or says inferred.

norms.text: The Naga-Kur hold the inner swamp and arm themselves from the bodies of their own dead.
Hospitality is offered to a guest whatever is planned for him afterwards.
Settled holds pay for quiet and do not say so.
Every tribe here keeps the Shadowscale tradition.

taboos.text: Naming who pays the tribeless camps.

values.text: The tally: what is owed to the deeps, paid in full.

contempts.text: Settled tribes who buy safety with silence.
Outsiders who dig the xanmeers for coin.

place.text: The deeps are the old country, uncleared and unmapped.

work.text: Hunting, the camps and the rites.

people.text: A stranger is flesh, a guest or a buyer; which, he finds out.

faction.text: The Naga-Kur keep order here; the tribeless keep none.

hist.text: The trees here are fed by the dead, as they should be.

empire.text: The Empire's roads were robbed bare, then given up.

trade.text: The deeps sell quiet by the season and little else.

rumour.text: Cut-Rope's raiders are working the same tracks as the camps.

directions.text: Ways are told in stakes and cuts: past the ninth stake, left at the old cut.

addressTerms.text: Guests are welcomed formally and called by what they carry.
Kin are called by the hunt they share.

neverSaid.text: The price of a season's quiet.

grievances.text: The settled tribes are blamed for the North Cut camp, though Cut-Rope's raiders work the same tracks.
Long-Water Hold pays the camp not to work its stretch, from the hold's own stores.

rumours.text: A Death Hunt went out and came back one short.
Lights have been seen on Deepmire, a refuge that is kept empty except in need.

views.text: The coast sends ships and licences, but never a walker who can cross the deeps.
The Rose's walls stand empty now; its dead wander our edge.
The heartland tribes pray softer and pay less.
The coast tribes fish and stay out.
